The Backlog Is Not the Quarter

mentions.excerpt: Sam Badri, a Cisco veteran on Eisman’s show, estimates that nine in ten users still type a prompt and wait.

Sam Badri, on Eisman's program on September 28, described Cisco's real inflection as the point when large orders for switches built on its Silicon One chips started to land, six to nine months earlier.
